content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Round Rock

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review the specific education and hours-of-experience thresholds that apply to your background, then gather documentation. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can clarify whether you meet PMI's prerequisites before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and cover the full PMBOK® Guide curriculum. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and prepares you for exam content.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and experience. Pay the examination fee to finalize your application. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and Q&A forums—to reinforce your learning. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center on your timeline. You'll sit for a computer-based exam that assesses your mastery of project-management knowledge and skills.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle by completing approved training, volunteering, or publishing. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep the PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to support your continuous professional development.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
